name: Arhe
source:
This story takes place in a world governed by the Numerals, powerful ancient creatures known as Arkhe, representing the essence of creation itself.

The Arkhe divided the world two thousand years ago and crafted diverse races to rule. But over time, a struggle for supremacy ignited among them, sparking an enduring conflict that still rages on. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2977310/Arkhe/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事发生在一个由数字统治的世界，数字是强大的古代生物，被称为Arkhe，代表了造物本身的本质。

两千多年前，阿凯人分裂了世界，并创造了不同的种族来统治。但随着时间的推移，他们之间爆发了争夺霸权的斗争，引发了一场持续不断的持久冲突。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2977310/Arkhe/]Steam[/url]]
